description: This file defines the CKEditor5 class for Drupal, implementing a custom text editor plugin with configuration, validation, and form handling methods.

classes.name: CKEditor5
classes.description: Defines a CKEditor 5-based text editor plugin for Drupal, including configuration, validation, form handling, and plugin management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for CKEditor5 class, injecting dependencies and initializing properties.

methods.name: getDefaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default configuration settings for the CKEditor 5 plugin.

methods.name: validatePair
methods.description: Validates compatibility between a text editor and a text format, ensuring they are configured to work together.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for CKEditor 5, including toolbar, plugins, and plugin settings.

methods.name: shouldHaveVisiblePluginSettingsForm
methods.description: Determines if a plugin's settings form should be visible based on plugin definition and editor state.

methods.name: injectPluginSettingsForm
methods.description: Injects plugin-specific configuration forms into the main CKEditor 5 configuration form.

methods.name: assessActiveTextEditorAfterBuild
methods.description: Post-processing callback to update form state regarding whether CKEditor 5 is active.

methods.name: validateSwitchingToCKEditor5
methods.description: Validates if switching to CKEditor 5 is compatible with current configuration, providing user feedback.

methods.name: getGeneratedAllowedHtmlValue
methods.description: Provides the allowed HTML tags string for filter_html, based on validated configuration.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
methods.description: Validates the CKEditor 5 configuration form, including toolbar items and plugin settings.

methods.name: getSubmittedFilterFormat
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the submitted filter format configuration for validation.

methods.name: getEventualEditorWithPrimedFilterFormat
methods.description: Creates a clone of the editor with a filter format primed for validation, reflecting current form state.

methods.name: createEphemeralPairedEditor
methods.description: Creates a temporary clone of an editor with a specific filter format for validation purposes.

methods.name: mapViolationPropertyPathsToFormNames
methods.description: Maps config property paths to form element names for validation error reporting.

methods.name: mapPairViolationPropertyPathsToFormNames
methods.description: Maps validation violation property paths to form element names for pair validation errors.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, saving plugin settings and configuration.

methods.name: getJSSettings
methods.description: Generates JavaScript settings for initializing CKEditor 5 with toolbar and language options.

methods.name: getLibraries
methods.description: Returns the list of libraries needed for CKEditor 5, including translations.
